ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.







ABOUT THE ROLE

Ramp builds software that moves real money, from bill payments and corporate cards to reimbursements, accounting integrations, and travel. Our customers rely on us to keep their operations running: invoices get paid, books get closed, and finance leaders can trust the data behind every decision.

In this role, you will be the person who spots where customers are getting stuck and drives issues to a clear resolution. You will learn a complex product deeply enough to troubleshoot across payments, bank linking, accounting syncs, and card programs, then partner with teams across Engineering, Risk, Product, and Partnerships to get problems solved. This is not script-based support. You will triage, investigate, and make high-signal judgment calls throughout the day.

You will thrive in this role if you are a systems thinker and deeply customer obsessed. Support is the baseline. How you think about improving processes, tools, and outcomes is what sets you apart.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Be the voice of Ramp's Customer Support. You'll spend your day engaging with customers, primarily via live calls, email, and chat.

 - Diagnose across a broad product surface. Ramp isn't one product — it's payments, cards, travel, accounting integrations, and more. You'll need to understand how they connect and where they break.

 - Operate with an ownership mindset, managing escalations end-to-end. You take full accountability for every ticket you handle. When an issue crosses team boundaries — risk, engineering, product, partnerships — you route it correctly, follow up, and make sure the customer isn't left waiting. You'll work across Zendesk, internal tooling, and Slack-based escalation workflows.

 - Build and shape AI tools, not just use them. Ramp is building AI into CX operations. You'll use AI-powered research tools and proprietary tools like Glass daily, provide direct feedback on what's working, and play an active role in how these tools evolve. You're not just a user — you're a builder. We are all builders at Ramp.

 - Ship improvements, not just flag them. When you notice a process gap, a missing SOP, or a knowledge base article that's sending associates down the wrong path, you don't just raise it — you have the autonomy to roll up your sleeves and fix it. Leverage AI to solve problems, build automations, and improve the systems around you. The best people in this role make the whole team better.

 - Communicate with precision and empathy. Our customers are financially sophisticated. You need to explain what's happening, what you're doing about it, and what they should expect — clearly and without filler.


WHAT YOU NEED

 - You're a systems thinker: you don't just solve the ticket in front of you, you ask why the problem exists and how to prevent it from happening again.

 - You actively use AI tools — Claude, Notion AI, research and workflow tools — and can demonstrate how you've applied them to get real work done. This is a hard requirement.

The mission

Whop is on a mission to deliver everyone a sustainable income. Today, 50,000 people make money on Whop every month, and Whop users are on track to earn more than $7 billion this year. You will run the talent moments that matter most, including performance, calibration, promotion, and engagement cycles, and make sure each one leads to better decisions, not just completed forms.

 - Meals, wellness support, and office benefits designed for an in-person team

ABOUT ZIP

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.




YOUR ROLE

As a member of Zip's GTM Strategy & Operations team, you'll be the primary business partner to Zip's Customer Success organization — owning the operating rhythms, models, and metrics that determine how the team covers, retains, and grows the customer base.

You'll bring structure to a fast-scaling org: standardizing ways of working across post-sales, and driving the cross-functional collaboration with adjacent teams (from Sales & Account Management to Technical Support) that a coherent customer experience depends on.

You’ll operate as a true business partner and execution arm for our Post-Sales leaders - owning the core rhythms, models, and metrics that power Customer Success performance.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own post-sales operations for the org: Lead day-to-day operations and long-term planning, including book design and rebalancing, segmentation, metrics, reporting, and "whatever it takes."

 - Act as a strategic thought partner: Be the go-to partner for post-sales leadership and execs - whether it's solving complex problems, framing key decisions, or bringing structure to ambiguity.

 - Drive GTM cadence and accountability: Run the operating rhythm - owning book reviews, renewal forecast calls, at-risk and churn reviews, QBRs, and leadership syncs. You'll push velocity, track outcomes, and ensure every meeting drives impact.

 - Lead cross-functional execution: Work across Sales, Marketing, CS, Product, and Finance to drive strategic initiatives forward - bringing a GTM perspective to company-wide efforts and ensuring alignment across teams.

 - Build with data: Use SQL, spreadsheets, and BI tools to structure analysis, validate assumptions, and uncover insights that improve GTM execution and drive growth

 - Own special projects: From building a renewal forecast process to redefining our health score system - you’ll own critical, high-impact workstreams that move the business forward.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 8+ years of experience in customer success/post-sale operations, sales strategy, revenue operations, consulting, investing, or a similar high-performance environment.

 - Strong analytical and modeling skills - you're fluent in Excel/Sheets and can write SQL or are willing to learn.

 - Deep understanding of the post-sale customer lifecycle and SaaS business models, with battle-tested views on retention and expansion metrics (NRR, GRR, churn), account health and CSM/Solutions Consultant coverage models, and implementation/time-to-value velocity.

 - Experience working closely with RevOps systems like Salesforce, Gong, Superset and others.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication - you can structure thinking clearly, write concise memos, and present to executives with confidence.

 - Attention to detail - you go deep on problems, sweat the edge cases, and set the quality bar high.

 - High bias for action - you move fast, think in tradeoffs, and find a way forward when others see blockers.

The Deal Desk function partners across Chainalysis to help teams structure and execute complex commercial deals across the Americas. Combining commercial judgment with analytical rigor, the team develops solutions that meet customer needs while aligning with Chainalysis’ pricing, product, and contractual guidelines.

You’ll join a growing function working closely with Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, Legal, Product, Marketing, and other teams. The team helps navigate deal complexity, bring clarity to commercial decisions, and move opportunities forward. This role offers broad exposure to Chainalysis’ go-to-market operations and the opportunity to help shape how we support and scale commercial deals as the company grows.



In this role, you’ll:

 - Support Sales teams in structuring, pricing, and quoting complex commercial deals, developing a deep understanding of Chainalysis’ licensing, subscription, and pricing models to recommend deal structures that meet customer needs while aligning with company strategy and commercial guidelines.

 - Review deal requests, analyze pricing and discounts, and present recommendations to business approvers, while providing guidance on negotiations, contract objections, alternative deal structures, and non-standard order-form requirements.

 - Serve as a key point of contact for Sales on deal pricing, quoting, and deviations from standard processes, helping Sales leaders prioritize opportunities around month-end, quarter-end, and year-end deadlines.

 - Troubleshoot complex quoting challenges in Salesforce CPQ and maintain a knowledge base of recurring deal issues to improve consistency and support Sales effectiveness.

 - Partner closely with Legal, Product, Finance, Revenue Operations, and other cross-functional teams to resolve complex commercial requirements and support accurate forecasting and order booking.

 - Identify and deliver process improvements, including enhancements to Salesforce workflows and system automation, to streamline deal desk operations and improve the overall sales process.

 - Combine commercial judgment with analytical rigor to develop customer-focused solutions that align with Chainalysis’ pricing strategy, product offerings, and contractual guidelines.

 - Navigate increasingly complex commercial arrangements, providing strategic deal-structuring guidance as the business evolves towards consumption-based pricing models.

 - Partner closely with Sales teams to structure, price, and quote complex deals. Develop deep expertise in Chainalysis’ licensing, subscription, and pricing models to recommend commercially sound deal structures that balance customer needs, business objectives, and internal commercial guidelines.

We are looking for candidates who have/are:

 - 5 years of experience in Deal Desk or a related function, preferably within enterprise SaaS or financial technology.

 - Proven experience structuring and reviewing complex SaaS transactions in a fast-growing, multinational company.

 - Experience with Salesforce CRM and Salesforce CPQ, or similar quoting systems.

 - Strong analytical skills, including pricing, discount, and commercial analysis.

 - A solid understanding of Quote to Order processes within the Lead to Cash lifecycle.

 - Experience partnering cross-functionally with Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, Legal, Product, or other business teams.

 - Strong judgment and communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and manage competing priorities.

 - The ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment and respond calmly to high-pressure requests.

 - Strong organizational and workload-management skills, with the ability to prioritize based on risk and business needs.

 - A proactive approach to improving processes and systems.

Language requirements:

 - English: Native or equivalent professional fluency

 - Spanish: Required

 - Portuguese: Preferred

About the Role
 As the Data Strategy and Operations Manager at Abnormal AI, you will own our go-to-market data quality strategy and serve as the steward of data across Salesforce and the systems around it. You will design the processes, controls, and intelligent workflows that keep data accurate, enriched, and trusted at scale, so Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance can give executive leadership reliable metrics. You will decide where AI agents and automation take over repetitive data work and where human judgment still matters, and partner with cross-functional teams to evaluate system changes that affect our data programs.
 Who you are
- Data obsessed and just as obsessed with removing manual work, with a habit of automating any process that relies on fixing records by hand
- Curious about AI and a daily user, with experience shipping workflows with LLMs, agents, or AI-assisted tooling, and able to tell a useful application from a demo
- Eager to build and shape a program rather than only maintain one, and able to create systems that hold up at global scale
- Highly analytical, able to see the big picture and spot trends and gaps, then zoom in with practical, specific recommendations
- Steady when juggling multiple priorities in a constantly changing environment
- A good teammate, dedicated to the mission, who likes to have fun along the way
 What you will do
- Set the data governance strategy, standards, ownership model, and source-of-truth hierarchy for GTM data across Salesforce and connected systems
- Establish policies, access controls, and field-level definitions, including record creation and deprecation rules, and monitor adherence
- Ensure compliance and security of our data, and flag risks to IT, security, and leadership
- Replace high-volume manual tasks (deduplication, enrichment, account matching, hierarchy mapping, routing, anomaly review) with automated and AI-assisted workflows
- Design and maintain AI agents and LLM-powered workflows that classify, enrich, validate, and remediate data, with guardrails, human review points, and accuracy measurement
- Build automated data quality monitoring that detects issues early, alerts the right owner, and fixes them without human intervention where appropriate
- Evaluate and select AI, enrichment, and automation tooling, run pilots, and measure impact through time saved, accuracy gains, and coverage
- Own the enrichment strategy and keep account firmographics accurate: hierarchies, employee count, location, industry, and Fortune ranking
- Act as the subject matter expert for Business Ops, Marketing Ops, Customer Success, and Finance, run a defined feedback intake process, and support consistent reporting and dashboards
- Manage a portfolio of data quality and automation projects with clear priorities, owners, and outcomes
 Must Haves
- 5+ years in Sales Operations, Data Operations, or a similar analytical or systems role
- Hands-on experience building automation with AI or LLM tools (agents, prompt-driven workflows, AI-assisted enrichment), with shipped examples you can easily share
- Strong understanding of data lifecycle management, data modeling, master data management, and requirements gathering
- Demonstrated understanding of Salesforce automation, including Flow and validation rules, and experience working closely with admins
- Experience implementing and managing data and enrichment tools, including AI-native tools such as Clay, Kernel, Starbridge, and Onfire
- Proficiency in Excel
- Track record of leading data management projects from idea to result
- Sound judgment about where AI is reliable and where it needs controls for privacy, security, and accuracy
- Detail oriented, self-motivated, proactive, and quick to learn new tools
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including explaining technical and AI concepts to non-technical partners
- Preferred: experience with workflow automation or integration platfor

 Figure Technology Solutions, Inc. (Nasdaq: FIGR; OPEN: FGRS) is the leading blockchain-native capital marketplace for the origination, funding, sale and trading of tokenized assets. The fastest growing components are Figure Connect, its credit marketplace, and Democratized Prime, Figure’s on-chain lend-borrow marketplace. Figure is the market leader in real-world asset (RWA) tokenization. The company has received triple-A ratings from S&P and Moody’s on multiple loan securitizations, the first of its kind for blockchain finance.
We’re proud to be recognized as one of Forbes’ Top 50 Fintech Companies and CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies .

You’ll be the primary point of accountability for the ongoing performance, compliance, and economics of these portfolios and joint ventures, bridging deal structuring and live operations by turning portfolio management objectives and servicing, warehouse, and sale documents into repeatable practices. This is a newly created role on our Capital Markets team, supporting a leading structured finance platform with multiple institutional counterparties.
 What You’ll Do 
- Track performance of mortgage assets, including origination trends, payoffs, delinquency, extensions, draws, and loss metrics across warehouse and owned positions
- Produce recurring portfolio reports for internal and institutional stakeholders, and support board and investor reporting cycles
- Maintain a current view of concentration limits, eligibility criteria, and covenant compliance across the portfolio
- Build and maintain portfolio dashboards and trackers covering performance, cash flows, and key risk metrics
- Manage day-to-day portfolio operations, including delinquency tracking and cash and collateral reconciliation
- Apply the portfolio’s governing agreements to day-to-day decisions, including expense sharing, decision rights, and waterfall mechanics
- Support forward flow and loan sale relationships, including compliance with applicable purchase and forward flow agreements
- Coordinate with Legal and Compliance on counterparty notifications, consents, and amendments as the portfolio evolves
- Oversee investment vehicle mechanics for joint ventures, including capital calls, distributions, and investor reporting cycles
- Partner with deal and transaction management, structuring, and compliance teams on new originations, securitizations, and portfolio sales
- Work with Finance and Accounting on cash reconciliation, fee distributions, and portfolio economics
- Collaborate with Treasury on warehouse facility utilization and borrowing-base reporting for the portfolio
 What We Look For 
- 4+ years in portfolio or asset management, structured finance, or capital markets operations, with direct exposure to residential transition loans, HELOCs, RMBS, or warehouse-financed loan portfolios
- Comfort interpreting and applying governing agreements, servicing agreements, and financing documents
- Ability to read and apply legal and transaction documents directly rather than relying on summaries
- Strong Excel, SQL, Python, Tableau, and financial modeling skills, with comfort building and maintaining portfolio tracking and reporting tool

Monitor travel updates, schedule changes, and supplier communications
